from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest,write_json

out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
members={}
for p in sorted((raw/"confirmation-readback-002").iterdir()):
 data=p.read_bytes()
 with (out/p.name).open("xb") as stream: stream.write(data)
 assert (out/p.name).read_bytes()==data
 members[p.name]={"sha256":file_digest(out/p.name),"bytes":len(data)}

write_json(out/"record.json",report)

assert len(new["assignments"])==6 and new["complete_records"]==6
assert new["scientific_acceptance"]=="not_granted" and new["robot_task_outcome"]=="unmeasured"
complete=json.loads((public/"complete-inspection.json").read_text())

assert complete["integrity"]=="verified_complete_store" and complete["process_outcome"]=="completed"
assert prefix["integrity"]=="verified_prefix" and prefix["process_outcome"]=="unknown"

except ValueError as error: old_error=str(error)
assert old_error=="Assessment reader, reference or interpreter changed",old_error
pub={"schema":"nisayon.temporal-public-closeout.v1","application_commit":report["application_commit"],"complete_inspect_command":"f3fb615c751841a085bd0bf0e5ecd73e","prefix_inspect_command":"a201bf90cc6b42fe9697595b845e0a27","assess_command":"2e8077e5c8c3480ca16915ceec00ab8a","read_assessment_command":"4e0e6f78fe17405ba3c44b1d6755ae4c","complete_records":new["complete_records"],"assigned_contract_counts":new["assigned_contract_counts"],"retrospective_counts":new["retrospective_counts"],"prefix":{"process_outcome":prefix["process_outcome"],"integrity":prefix["integrity"],"snapshot_sha256":prefix["snapshot_sha256"]},"old_assessment_current_reuse_error":old_error,"execution_or_retry_performed":False,"robot_task_outcome":"unmeasured","scientific_acceptance":"not_granted","archive":archive_packet(public,results/"public-closeout-001.tar.gz")}
write_json(results/"public-closeout-001.json",pub)
print(json.dumps({"confirmation_members":len(members),"confirmation_archive_bytes":archive["bytes"],"public_archive_bytes":pub["archive"]["bytes"],"old_reuse":old_error}))
